name: Trap Bar Jump
steps: Step inside a lightly loaded trap bar, grip both handles at their centers, and stand tall with arms straight.
Drop swiftly into a quarter-to-half squat with a flat back and braced core while keeping the handles centered at your sides.
Drive explosively upward through your hips, knees, and ankles to launch both feet cleanly off the floor.
Land softly with bent knees and hips to absorb the load quietly, pause to reset, and repeat.
tips: Keep your arms completely straight and let your legs generate all vertical jump velocity.
Use a light load that permits fast, high-velocity jumps and reset fully before every repetition.
